MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 45 ÷ 6? (1 mark)
   A. 8 remainder 3
   B. 7 remainder 4
   C. 7 remainder 3
   D. 6 remainder 9

2. Which of these is the unit of capacity? (1 mark)
   A. Hour
   B. Litre
   C. Kilogram
   D. Metre

3. A rectangle is cut into 12 equal parts and 5 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the rectangle is shaded? (1 mark)
   A. 5/7
   B. 7/12
   C. 5/12
   D. 12/5

4. Wairimu had d shillings and spent 45 shillings. Which expression shows the money she has left? (1 mark)
   A. d + 45
   B. 45 − d
   C. d − 45
   D. 45d

5. What is a quarter of a metre in centimetres? (1 mark)
   A. 4 cm
   B. 25 cm
   C. 250 cm
   D. 14 cm

6. Change 375 cm to metres and centimetres. (1 mark)
   A. 4 m 75 cm
   B. 3 m 75 cm
   C. 37 cm
   D. 4 m 25 cm

7. What is a plane figure? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of aeroplane
   B. A flat shape
   C. A curved line only
   D. A solid object

8. Cuboid A is 4 by 3 by 2 blocks (length, width, height). Cuboid B is 3 by 3 by 3 blocks. Which has the greater volume? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cuboid A
   C. It cannot be told
   D. Cuboid B

9. A bus leaves at 7:45 a.m. and the journey takes 2 hours 30 minutes. At what time does it arrive? (1 mark)
   A. 9:75 a.m.
   B. 10:45 a.m.
   C. 9:15 a.m.
   D. 10:15 a.m.

10. How many hours are in 3 days? (1 mark)
   A. 36 hours
   B. 180 hours
   C. 96 hours
   D. 72 hours

11. Which is a good tool for drawing straight lines in a table? (1 mark)
   A. A clock
   B. A measuring jug
   C. A ruler
   D. A beam balance

12. A square is covered with 8 rows of 8 unit squares. What is its area? (1 mark)
   A. 32 square units
   B. 72 square units
   C. 64 square units
   D. 16 square units

13. Four quarter turns make (1 mark)
   A. a half turn
   B. a three-quarter turn
   C. a quarter turn
   D. a full turn

14. An angle that is smaller than a right angle looks like (1 mark)
   A. a corner that is more closed than a square corner
   B. a circle
   C. a straight line
   D. a corner that is more open than a square corner

15. A book costs Ksh 45. How much do 24 books cost? (1 mark)
   A. 1,070 shillings
   B. 1,180 shillings
   C. 1,080 shillings
   D. 1,060 shillings

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Amina faces north. She makes a half turn, then a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way does she face at the end? (4 marks)

17. List three properties of a square. (3 marks)

18. Write the decimal 5.68 in a place value chart and say the place value of the 6 and of the 8. (4 marks)

19. Show two different ways to make Ksh 50 using coins and notes. (2 marks)

20. Write 583 in words. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 7 remainder 3
   6 × 7 = 42 and 45 − 42 = 3. So 45 ÷ 6 = 7 remainder 3. Check: 7 × 6 + 3 = 45.

2. B — Litre
   Capacity is measured in litres.

3. C — 5/12
   The whole has 12 equal parts and 5 are shaded, so 5/12 is shaded.

4. C — d − 45
   Spent means take away, so she has d − 45 left.

5. B — 25 cm
   1 m = 100 cm. Use this to change between the two units: a quarter of a metre in centimetres is 25 cm.

6. B — 3 m 75 cm
   375 ÷ 100 = 3 remainder 75. So 375 cm = 3 m 75 cm.

7. B — A flat shape
   A plane figure is a flat shape with length and width but no thickness.

8. D — Cuboid B
   A = 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 blocks. B = 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 blocks. Cuboid B is greater.

9. D — 10:15 a.m.
   7:45 + 2 hours = 9:45. 9:45 + 30 minutes = 10:15 a.m.

10. D — 72 hours
   1 day = 24 hours, so 3 × 24 = 72 hours.

11. C — A ruler
   A ruler is used to draw straight lines.

12. C — 64 square units
   Area = 8 × 8 = 64 square units.

13. D — a full turn
   Four quarters make one whole, so four quarter turns make one full turn.

14. A — a corner that is more closed than a square corner
   Its arms are closer together than the arms of a right angle.

15. C — 1,080 shillings
   Multiply to find the total. The answer is 1,080 shillings.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: East
   Working / marking points: A half turn from north gives south (2 marks). A quarter turn anticlockwise from south gives east (2 marks).

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Four equal sides, four right angles and four lines of symmetry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct property.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ones 5, tenths 6, hundredths 8. The 6 is in the tenths place and the 8 is in the hundredths place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct chart, 1 mark for each place value, 1 mark for using the decimal point correctly.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: one Ksh 50 note; or five Ksh 10 coins; or two Ksh 20 coins and one Ksh 10 coin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: five hundred and eighty-three
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "five hundred and"; 1 mark for "eighty-three" spelt correctly with a hyphen.
